fields.title: Heart valve replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Heart valve replacement is a complex operation that can save lives and improve the quality of life of people with serious heart conditions. The heart valves play a key part in maintaining proper circulation, but they can be damaged or become leaky for various reasons. In this article we describe the methods of diagnosis and treatment and the advantages of heart valve replacement in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Assessing the state of the heart valves is critically important before a decision on replacement is taken. Modern diagnostic methods include:

  • Echocardiography: a non-invasive method that uses ultrasound to create an image of the heart. Echocardiography allows the structure and function of the heart valves to be assessed and any damage or leakage to be identified.
  • Computed tomography (CT): this method provides detailed slices of the heart and valves, which helps doctors assess the situation more precisely and decide whether replacement is needed.
  • Cardiac catheterisation: an invasive procedure in which a catheter is passed through the blood vessels into the heart to measure pressures and assess the working of the valves.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of heart valve disease depends on the type and extent of the damage. The main treatments include:

  • Drug therapy: doctors may prescribe medicines to improve the function of the heart and control symptoms, but where the valves are seriously damaged surgery may be required.
  • Surgical repair: in some cases, where the damage to the valve is slight, it can be repaired rather than replaced.
  • Valve replacement: the most effective treatment where the heart valves are severely damaged or leaking. The replacement may be mechanical (an artificial prosthesis) or biological (a tissue prosthesis).

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is one of the world leaders in the surgical treatment of heart disease, including valve replacement. The advantages of heart valve replacement in Israel include:

  • Qualified specialists: Israeli cardiac surgeons have extensive experience and knowledge in heart valve replacement.
  • Modern technology and equipment: medical institutions in Israel are equipped with advanced devices and technology, which ensures a high level of professionalism and successful treatment results.
  • An individual approach to treatment: every patient is given an individual, comprehensive approach to treatment that takes account of their particular circumstances and needs.

Conclusion

Heart valve replacement is an effective operation that can considerably improve the quality of life of patients with serious heart conditions. It is important to seek help in good time and to choose qualified specialists. Israel, as a world leader in cardiac surgery, provides high-quality heart valve replacement using advanced technology and an individual approach to every patient. If you have problems with your heart valves, do not delay in consulting a doctor.

fields.title: Hip replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Hip replacement: an advanced approach in Israel

Hip replacement, or hip arthroplasty, is one of the most effective operations offered in Israel for the treatment of severe osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, injuries and other conditions that destroy the hip joint. The operation restores movement in the joint, considerably reduces or completely removes the pain, and greatly improves patients' quality of life.

Investigations before hip replacement

  1. Clinical examination
    Includes assessment of the symptoms, the degree of restricted movement and general health.
  2. X-rays
    The main diagnostic method, allowing the degree of damage to the joint to be established and the right implant to be chosen.
  3. MRI and CT
    Used for a detailed assessment of the bone, cartilage and soft tissues.
  4. Laboratory tests
    May be ordered to identify signs of inflammation, infection or autoimmune conditions.

Methods of hip replacement in Israel

  1. Total hip replacement
    Complete replacement of the joint with an artificial implant that reproduces its natural function.
  2. Minimally invasive surgical methods
    Shorten recovery time and reduce the risk of complications after the operation through the use of smaller incisions.
  3. The use of high-technology implants
    The application of the latest advances in materials science and biomechanics to produce durable and reliable prostheses.
  4. Computer planning and navigation
    Improves the precision with which the prosthesis is positioned, which contributes to a better functional result and a longer-lasting implant.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • Highly qualified specialists: Israel is home to some of the world's leading orthopaedic surgeons, with extensive experience in hip replacement.
  • An individualised approach: Every case is considered individually, and the plan for the operation and the choice of implant take account of the patient's anatomy and way of life.
  • Advanced medical technology: The use of modern equipment and materials makes operations highly precise and prostheses long-lasting.
  • Comprehensive rehabilitation: Includes individually designed exercise programmes aimed at rapid recovery and a return to an active life.

Hip replacement in Israel gives patients the chance to return to a full life without the pain and limitations of joint disease. Thanks to the comprehensive approach to treatment, patients can expect an individualised recovery programme and high standards of medical care.

fields.title: Female infertility
fields.bodyHtml:
Female infertility: advanced treatment in Israel

Female infertility is the inability to conceive after a year of regular sexual activity without contraception. Clinics in Israel offer a comprehensive approach to the diagnosis and treatment of female infertility, using the latest scientific advances and technology to improve the chances of conceiving successfully.

Diagnosis of female infertility:

  1. Gynaecological examination and history: Important for identifying possible physical causes of infertility, such as abnormalities in the development of the reproductive organs.
  2. Ultrasound scan: Allows the state of the ovaries, womb and fallopian tubes to be assessed.
  3. Hormone profile: Measurement of the key hormones affecting reproductive function.
  4. Hysterosalpingography (HSG): A contrast X-ray examination to assess whether the fallopian tubes are open.
  5. Laparoscopy: A minimally invasive operation used for a detailed examination of the pelvic organs and to identify endometriosis or other internal problems.
  6. Endometrial biopsy: A procedure to assess the state of the lining of the womb.

Treatments for female infertility:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Hormone therapy: The use of medicines to stimulate ovulation, such as clomifene citrate or gonadotropins.
    • Treatment of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS): A combination of medication and lifestyle changes to restore the ovulatory cycle.
  2. Surgery:
    • Laparoscopic surgery: Used to remove physical obstacles such as adhesions or areas of endometriosis that may prevent conception.
    • Hysteroscopic surgery: Removal of polyps or fibroids in the womb that may prevent an embryo implanting.
  3. Assisted reproductive technology (ART):
    • Artificial insemination (IUI): Introduction of sperm into the cavity of the womb at the time of ovulation.
    • In vitro fertilisation (IVF): Collection of eggs for fertilisation in the laboratory, followed by transfer of the embryo into the womb.
  4. Egg and embryo donation: An option for women who have problems with the quality of their eggs or genetic disorders.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: Close cooperation between gynaecologists, endocrinologists, fertility specialists and psychologists.
  • Advanced equipment and technology: The use of the most modern techniques and devices for diagnosis and treatment.
  • An individualised treatment plan: Every patient is given a personalised plan that takes account of every aspect of her health and her wishes.

Treatment of female infertility in Israel aims to achieve the best possible results, giving every woman the chance to experience the joy of motherhood.

fields.title: Goitre
fields.bodyHtml:
Goitre: modern treatment in Israel

A goitre is an enlargement of the thyroid gland, which can have various causes including a lack of iodine in the diet, autoimmune conditions, congenital factors and others. Israel uses a comprehensive approach to the diagnosis and treatment of goitre, combining advanced diagnostic methods, individualised treatment plans and modern surgical technology.

Diagnosis of goitre:

  1. Examination and palpation
    The doctor examines and feels the area of the neck to assess the size and consistency of the thyroid gland.
  2. Ultrasound scan
    The main diagnostic method, allowing the structure and size of the gland and the presence of nodules to be assessed.
  3. Blood tests
    Measurement of thyroid hormone levels (T3, T4) and thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) to establish how the thyroid gland is functioning.
  4. Biopsy
    Carried out where there are suspicious nodules, to rule out thyroid cancer.

Treatments for goitre in Israel:

  1. Drug treatment
    The use of medicines to correct thyroid hormone levels and reduce the size of the goitre.
  2. Iodine supplements
    Prescribed where iodine deficiency is the main cause of the goitre.
  3. Surgery
    Recommended where the goitre is large, presses on the surrounding tissues, is suspected of being cancerous, or where drug treatment has not worked. Israeli surgeons use minimally invasive methods, including endoscopic techniques.
  4. Radioactive iodine therapy
    Used in overactive thyroid caused by a goitre, and in some forms of thyroid cancer.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A personalised approach
    The treatment plan is drawn up individually for every patient, taking account of the features of the condition and their general health.
  • Highly qualified specialists
    Israeli doctors are internationally recognised and have extensive experience in diagnosing and treating conditions of the thyroid gland.
  • Access to the newest technology
    The use of modern diagnostic and surgical equipment ensures accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.
  • A comprehensive approach
    Specialists from various fields of medicine are involved in treatment, which ensures the patient's full recovery.

Treatment of goitre in Israel aims to address the causes of the condition, correct the function of the thyroid gland and prevent complications, allowing patients to lead a full life.
